_documentation: Livestream link for the ESSC conference, surfaced on essc-2026.html (+ FR + DE) by the programme renderer. One Zoom webinar link is used for every session. The renderer shows it only while the current time is within [start, end], so nothing stale appears before or after the conference. To take it down, blank `url` (or delete this file): the page fails soft. Times carry an explicit +02:00 (CEST) offset so the gate is correct in any visitor's timezone. This file is hand-maintained and is NOT touched by the daily Indico sync.
